setup.command:
# Best-effort: install git-lfs for Hoplite's PR packaging (git lfs ls-files probe). Never fail provisioning.
if command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 0
fi
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
fi
if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  brew install git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
fi
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ver=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/git-lfs/git-lfs/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | tr -d v)
  if [ -n "$ver" ] && curl -fsSL "https://github.com/git-lfs/git-lfs/releases/download/v${ver}/git-lfs-linux-amd64-v${ver}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/git-lfs.tgz; then
    mkdir -p "${HOME}/.local/bin"
    tar -xzf /tmp/git-lfs.tgz -C /tmp "git-lfs-${ver}/git-lfs" && install -m 0755 "/tmp/git-lfs-${ver}/git-lfs" "${HOME}/.local/bin/git-lfs" && exit 0
  fi
fi
exit 0
